# BlendMode

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · enum

```csharp
public enum BlendMode
```

How a sprite batch's sprites combine with what's behind them. Colors are premultiplied, so a sprite's transparent parts leave what's behind alone in every mode but [`Opaque`](#opaque).

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="alpha"></a>`Alpha` | The sprite covers what's behind it, as far as it's opaque. |
| <a name="additive"></a>`Additive` | The sprite's color adds to what's behind it, for light, fire and glows. |
| <a name="multiply"></a>`Multiply` | The sprite's color multiplies what's behind it, which darkens: for shadows. |
| <a name="screen"></a>`Screen` | The inverse of multiplying the inverses, which lightens without blowing out. |
| <a name="opaque"></a>`Opaque` | The sprite replaces what's behind it, alpha included. |
